answer: Random jury of 9 drawn without replacement at the karst: a farm controlling fraction k of identities gets a full corrupt jury only k⁹ of the time. The velvet of honest stake stays untouchable — sampling enforces it. Any attacker forging identities hits the ferrous wall: 30% share yields 0.3⁹ ≈ 0.00002, so verdicts never swing. The mechanism works because Byzantine tolerance is baked into combinatorial draw odds, not into trusting any single node.
